Primary additionally computes exact endpoint-fiber distributions: 32 each Hamming-one and Hamming-three endpoint pairs, with 672/756 total paths and 144/18 frozen paths per fiber. Finite Q4 only.

value.rationale: A complete finite classification of a natural strictly endpoint-preserving local Hamiltonian-path rerouting problem on Q4. The sharp segregation into frozen states and one mobile class for every one of 64 endpoint pairs, with strongly different frozen fractions for distance 1 and 3, supplies a meaningful combinatorial obstruction independent of counting the paths themselves. No higher-dimensional theorem is asserted.
